value.custom:
<rsb:check value="[xpath('std_desadv_header/std_desadv_dn_header/plant_code') | def | trim]">
  <rsb:set attr="plant.code" value="[xpath('std_desadv_header/std_desadv_dn_header/plant_code') | def | trim]"/>
  <rsb:else>
   <rsb:throw code="DataMiss" desc="BBA ASN Miss plant_code"/>
  </rsb:else>
</rsb:check>

<rsb:set attr="input.portId" value="BBA_XMLToEDIFACT" />
<rsb:set attr="input.name" value="UNBControlNumber" />
<rsb:set attr="input.maxvalue" value="999999999" />
<rsb:set attr="input.startWith" value="1"/>

<!-- <rsb:call op="connector.rsc/portGetNextId" authtoken="test:0e4P5r8z8T3t9k9H7l6q" in="input" out="out2"> -->
<rsb:call op="connector.rsc/portGetNextId" authtoken="ops:3t3F1e2r6C6a5s2U7j1m" in="input" out="out2">
  <rsb:set attr="control.number" value="[out2.value | def]" />
</rsb:call>

<rsb:set attr="dn.num" value="0"/>
<rsb:set attr="asn.number" value="[xpath('asn_number') | def | trim]"/>

<rsb:check value="[xpath(doc_date) | def | trim]">
<rsb:else>
  <rsb:throw code="DataMiss" desc="BBA ASN Miss doc_date"/>
</rsb:else>
</rsb:check>

<rsb:check value="[xpath('shipment_number')]">
  <rsb:else>
    <rsb:throw code="DataMiss" desc="BBA ASN Miss shipment_number"/>
  </rsb:else>
</rsb:check>

<rsb:check value="[xpath('desadv_inner') | def | trim]">
  <rsb:else>
    <rsb:throw code="DataMiss" desc="BMW ASN Miss desadv_inner"/>
  </rsb:else>
  <rsb:set attr="inner.number" value="[xpath('desadv_inner') | def | trim]"/>
  <rsb:unset item="tmp"/>
  <rsb:set item="tmp"/>
  <rsb:enum list="[inner.number]" separator=",">
    <rsb:set attr="tmp.serialNumbersInTare#" value="[_value]" />
  </rsb:enum>
</rsb:check>
<rsb:check attr="tmp.serialNumbersInTare#">
  <rsb:set attr="tmp.cnt" value="[tmp.serialNumbersInTare#|div(5)|ceiling]" />
  <rsb:enum range="1..[tmp.cnt]">
    <rsb:set attr="tmp.idx" value="[_value]" />
    <rsb:if exp="[tmp.idx] > 97">
      <rsb:throw code="400" desc="GIN+AW repeat max 97" />
    </rsb:if>
    <rsb:set attr="tmp.GIN0201" value="[tmp.serialNumbersInTare#[tmp.idx|add(-1)|multiply(5)|add(1)] | def]" />
    <rsb:set attr="tmp.GIN0301" value="[tmp.serialNumbersInTare#[tmp.idx|add(-1)|multiply(5)|add(2)] | def]" />
    <rsb:set attr="tmp.GIN0401" value="[tmp.serialNumbersInTare#[tmp.idx|add(-1)|multiply(5)|add(3)] | def]" />
    <rsb:set attr="tmp.GIN0501" value="[tmp.serialNumbersInTare#[tmp.idx|add(-1)|multiply(5)|add(4)] | def]" />
    <rsb:set attr="tmp.GIN0601" value="[tmp.serialNumbersInTare#[tmp.idx|add(-1)|multiply(5)|add(5)] | def]" />

<rsb:check value="[xpath(inner_package_qty)|def|trim]">
  <rsb:else>
    <rsb:throw code="Miss Data" desc="BBA ASN Miss inner_package_qty"/>
  </rsb:else>
</rsb:check>

<rsb:set attr="inner.number3" value="[xpath('inner_package_number') | def | trim]"/>
<rsb:enum list="[inner.number3]" separator=",">
